about.description: Full stack developer with an M.Sc. in Robotics, interested in building reliable products that turn complex systems and AI capabilities into practical software.

price-watch.title: Price Watch
price-watch.description: A personal price-tracking system for products and subscriptions with multi-source comparison, price history, review workflows, and automated scraping.
highlights: Cloud web app + private local scraper architecture
Multi-source price tracking with normalized unit comparison
Price history, target prices, and suspicious scrape review
Dockerized deployment with CI/CD and cloud hosting

project_b23afe49-7a88-4277-835b-9b4f3cc4.title: AI Avatar
project_b23afe49-7a88-4277-835b-9b4f3cc4.description: A local-first AI Avatar system combining local language models, character expressions and gestures, speech synthesis, and persistent conversation storage in a visual-novel-style interactive interface.
highlights: Local Qwen inference with structured emotion and gesture decisions
Local CosyVoice3 speech synthesis with reference voice support
Deterministic C# control for avatar state, motion policy, and TTS behavior
SQLite persistence for conversations, messages, and LLM / TTS telemetry

items.description:
Developed skills in web development using React and C#, as well as experience with AI and Ollama.

Internship: Working as a web developer, responsible for the development, deployment, and maintenance of websites.

Studied robotics, embedded systems and artificial intelligence. For my master's thesis, I developed a radar-based hand gesture recognition system using Python, TensorFlow, and convolutional neural networks (CNNs). The system achieved 95% classification accuracy with a prediction time of approximately 25 ms.
items.thesis: Implementation of Machine Learning Algorithm for Radar-Based Hand Gesture Recognition
